description: A woman with long wavy brown hair stands at the centre front, holding a pair of scissors in one hand and a cut lock of dark hair raised high in the other. Around her, women in headscarves and men raise fists and hair locks on a city street at dusk, with bare trees, apartment blocks, smoke and orange fire glow in the background. It is an oil-painting style image with no visible text, no frame, and no blood or injury.
